title: Position
description: Where the drum sits during gameplay, in the free space osu!taiko leaves around its lane. Below lane, left (default) is under the hit area; above lane uses the gap between the health bar and the score. Fine-tune with the offsets.

title: Horizontal offset / px
description: Nudges the drum right (positive) or left (negative) from its position, in 1080p pixels.

title: Vertical offset / px
description: Nudges the drum down (positive) or up (negative) from its position, in 1080p pixels. Skins that move the lane may need this.

title: Backing
description: none floats the drum on the game with a text shadow only; scrim adds a soft dark fade behind it for bright map backgrounds; panel draws a graphite 18-LAB panel.

title: Accent
description: Colour of the brand tick, peak KPS and hand balance fill: map takes a tonal accent from the current beatmap's background (amber when the map has none); 18-lab always uses amber. Drum zone colours are set by Colour mode.

title: Show stats
description: Show the stats beside the drum: live keys per second with the attempt's peak, left/right hand balance, the last 24 hits by hand, alternation rate (share of consecutive hits on opposite hands; simultaneous big-note doubles are not counted) and same-hand repeats. Off leaves the drum and its four zone counts.

title: Drum size
description: Drum diameter: small 128 px, medium 156 px, large 196 px (before Scale).

title: Colour mode
description: How lit zones and the hit strip are coloured: by note type (centre don red, rim kat blue), by hand (left blue, right amber; also colours the hand balance bar), or a single neutral tone. In the hit strip don hits are solid and kat hits hollow in every mode.

title: Summary on results
description: On the results screen after a taiko play, show one line in the free right part of osu!'s header: peak KPS, hand balance, alternation, same-hand repeats and per-zone counts (osu! shows none of these).

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: Show the small 18—LAB tag above the drum and the results summary.
